# Third-party data: loonaire/dofushistory

Source: https://github.com/loonaire/dofushistory (site https://loonaire.github.io/dofushistory/), commit
`3d58e113dbb1918dab479ae7351683794c8a3615`, fetched 2026-10-10 with `gh api …/contents`. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0
(attribution: loonaire). These are community articles in French: secondary sources. They link to Wayback captures,
which are the primary sources.

| File | Repo path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `beta1adofus1-9.md` | `content/Dofus/Histoire de la beta a la 1.29/beta1adofus1-9/index.md` | Version-by-version history v1b→1.9 with release dates (v1b 15 Oct 2003, v2b 28 Oct 2003, v4b 22 Dec 2003, **v5b 13 Jan 2004**, v6b 27 Jan 2004, v7b 25 Feb 2004 …) and links to beta forum posts and screenshots. Says lang, login UI and maps were server-side and are lost |
| `changelogsbeta.md` | `content/Dofus/changelogs/changelogsbeta/index.md` | Transcribed official beta changelogs (v2b, v9b, v9.1b, v10b, v11b, v13b, v15b, v17.2b; **v5b "Indisponible"**) |
| `help.md` | `content/help/_index.md` | The author's wanted list. They have only v5b and v7b among betas, and are looking for `DofusLoginInterface.swf` and the 1.0 `webLoaderUI.swf`. Contact: Twitter/Discord `@loonaire` |
| `fonctionsabandonnesclient.md` | `content/Dofus/Articles Dofus1/fonctionsabandonnesclient/index.md` | Abandoned client features (later versions) |
| `Lespremiersmonstresetpnjdedofus.md` | `content/Dofus/Articles Dofus1/Lespremiersmonstresetpnjdedofus/index.md` | The beta-era bestiary (58 monsters). Says the beta monster sprites were replaced around v11b/v12b |
